name: OpenAI TTS
summary: 使用 OpenAI / OpenRouter 兼容 TTS API 进行语音合成。
author: poyih & Claude

options.title: API URL
options.desc: 自定义 API 地址，用于代理或兼容服务。支持填写域名、/v1 基地址或完整接口地址；OpenRouter 可填写 https://openrouter.ai、https://openrouter.ai/api、https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 或完整 /api/v1/audio/speech 地址。仅建议使用 HTTPS；本机回环地址除外。

options.title: Allow insecure remote HTTP
options.desc: 危险选项。仅在必须连接不支持 HTTPS 的远程兼容服务时开启；API Key 和待合成文本会以明文传输。本机 localhost/127.0.0.0/8/[::1] 无需开启。

options.title: Model
options.desc: Select a common TTS model, or choose Custom and fill a model ID below. gpt-4o-mini-tts is the newest steerable model; pin the 2025-12-15 snapshot for reproducible voices.

options.title: Custom Model ID
options.desc: 可选。用于填写 OpenRouter 或其他兼容服务的完整模型 ID，例如 openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15。填写后会覆盖上方 Model 预设。

options.title: Voice (tts-1 / tts-1-hd)
options.desc: Used when Model is tts-1 or tts-1-hd. Custom Voice ID below overrides this selection.

options.title: Voice (gpt-4o-mini-tts family)
options.desc: Used when Model is any gpt-4o-mini-tts snapshot, including OpenRouter IDs. Custom Voice ID below overrides this selection.

options.title: Custom Voice ID
options.desc: 可选。覆盖上方 Voice 预设。非 OpenRouter 地址下，voice_... ID 会作为 OpenAI voice 对象发送（需具备相应资格）；OpenRouter 地址下始终按模型支持的音色字符串发送。

options.title: Speed
options.desc: Only applies to tts-1 / tts-1-hd. gpt-4o-mini-tts does not use the speed parameter; control pacing via Instructions instead.

options.title: Audio Format
options.desc: OpenAI supports all six formats; AAC validation accepts ADTS and MP4/M4A containers (not ADIF). OpenRouter only supports MP3 and PCM, so other selections auto-fallback to MP3. Headerless PCM is wrapped as a 24 kHz, mono, 16-bit WAV for Bob playback.

textConfig.placeholderText: Control voice style, tone, emotion. Works with gpt-4o-mini-tts snapshots and OpenRouter IDs.
